references.text: The same expression about a three-day journey into the wilderness to sacrifice to the Lord, given as an instruction to Moses at the burning bush
Moses and Aaron repeat the demand for a three-day journey into the wilderness to sacrifice to the Lord, the God of Israel
God's promise that the people will serve him on this mountain after deliverance from Egypt
Moses insists that they must have animals for sacrifice, and that the Lord will show them what to offer
The Lord's command to Pharaoh to let the people go so they can serve him in the wilderness
